I love Pinterest. I always have. I’ve been using this app since early 2020 and I have loved every single use of it. Until now. When you go on your feed, your bound to see ai images everywhere that aren’t even flagged as ai by their bad reviewing system controlled by robots. When there is a post that isn’t ai, Pinterest just… Marks it as ai? This can cause hate to the original creator and has the potential to just overall mess up their reputation. Pinterest will also take down other people’s pins that you saved for reasons that aren’t even true. My pins are full of art and cool objects like cute colored buttons and stuffed animals and such. I get an email every single day telling me that my posts were taken down for, “self harm related content”. This is not true for any of my pins and it then they tell you that they will have to take, “action” on your account (AKA banning you) for something that you didn’t do and have overall no control over. Pinterest also does not show you the pin that their ai has taken down for quite literally no reason, so you cannot make an appeal because you don’t know what they took down. Please fix this, Pinterest. I want to delete your app, along with many other people agreeing with me online and in real life. Goodbye.
